parsed.quote: Please submit it on the portal.

facts.claim: Naveen Gupta of the Incubation Cell asked Arjun to share the signed incubation agreement so the cell can activate the seat.
Ritika Sharma wrote that the monthly progress report was due on the fifteenth of September, on the portal.
Ekta Bhalla of the Incubation Cell wrote that the invoice for the two co-working seats is due on the thirtieth of September, and asked Arjun to confirm the billing name.
All three asks are open and wait on us.
The file's account admin situation is now seen through the twenty-fourth of September, its record still saying decided and deferred.

inferences.claim: The fifteenth has passed; whether the report went onto the portal is not in the file, and the portal, not the mail, would show it.
The seat still waits on the signed agreement, weeks after Naveen asked.
The invoice falls due within the week, so Ekta's is the one ask whose date is still ahead.
The cell treats Nimbus Labs as admitted — a seat to activate, a monthly report, an invoice for co-working seats — so the brief's line that the founder applied is behind the mail.

patterns.claim: After acceptance the programme's quiet is rarely the risk — the founders' is: the papers are ours to produce.
A programme's own date does not move; work is set back from it.

hypotheses.proposition: The monthly report is on the portal and simply was not mentioned in mail.
hypotheses.needs: The portal's record for the report.

hypotheses.proposition: The agreement is held up by its terms rather than forgotten.
hypotheses.needs: The founder's word on the agreement.

unknowns.question: Whether the monthly report is on the portal.
unknowns.relevance: If it is not, it needs filing today with a word to Ritika; if it is, nothing more.

unknowns.question: Which name the co-working invoice should carry — the company's or another.
unknowns.relevance: Ekta needs it before the invoice falls due on the thirtieth.

unknowns.question: Whether the agreement is signed.
unknowns.relevance: It decides whether the move is to sign or only to send.

frames.primary: An incubation cell onboarding Nimbus Labs, now with three people waiting on three asks: Naveen's signed agreement for the seat, Ritika's monthly report whose date has passed, and Ekta Bhalla's request to confirm the billing name for the co-working seats invoice due on the thirtieth.
rivals: Three separate admin chores from one cell that can be answered one by one as they fall due.
An incubatee relationship starting to fray because nothing has gone back from us in weeks.

expected_vs_actual.expected: The papers come in from our side before the programme's first day — the programme's quiet is rarely the risk, ours is.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Three asks are open — the agreement, the report and now Ekta Bhalla's billing name — and nothing has gone back from us by mail.

scenarios.do_nothing: The seat stays inactive, the report's status stays unknown, and the invoice falls due on the thirtieth without a billing name — lost on dates rather than on merit.
scenarios.act: One sitting today clears all three: the agreement sent, the report checked and filed, the billing name confirmed.
scenarios.best: The seat is active, the report is on the portal, and the invoice goes out under the right name before the thirtieth.
scenarios.worst: The cell starts chasing and reads Nimbus Labs as an incubatee who does not answer.
signals_to_watch: A reminder from Naveen, Ritika or Ekta.
The portal's record for the monthly report.
The invoice arriving under a name.

reasons: Three asks from the cell wait on us, two of them for weeks.
The report's date has passed and the invoice falls due on the thirtieth.
The seat cannot be activated until the agreement is back.

next_move.what: Answer the cell's three asks today: send Naveen the signed incubation agreement, confirm the billing name to Ekta before the thirtieth, and check the portal for the monthly report — if it is not there, file it and tell Ritika.
next_move.for_whom: Naveen Gupta, Ekta Bhalla and Ritika Sharma at the Incubation Cell

parsed.alternative: If the agreement cannot go today, tell Naveen when it will, and still answer Ekta and settle the report.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Nothing to wait for — all three moves are ours. Each ask is done when the cell confirms it or the portal shows it.
parsed.done_when: Naveen confirms the seat, the portal shows the monthly report, and Ekta has the billing name before the thirtieth.
parsed.draft: Hi Naveen and Ekta, sorry for the slow reply. Naveen, the signed incubation agreement is attached — please go ahead with the seat. Ekta, please bill the co-working seats to Nimbus Labs Private Limited. Thanks, Arjun
